import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static int n;
    static List<Long>[] ve = new ArrayList[11];
    static long[] sum = new long[11];
    static final int N = 1000000;
    static final long mod1 = 998244353;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007;
    static long cnt = 0;
    static long tmp = 0;
    static long ans = 0;

    static long read() throws IOException {
        int x = 0;
        int f = 1;
        int c;
        while (true) {
            c = System.in.read();
            if (c == -1) break;
            if (Character.isDigit(c)) break;
            if (c == '-') f = -1;
        }
        do {
            x = (x << 3) + (x << 1) + (c ^ 48);
            c = System.in.read();
        } while (Character.isDigit(c));
        return f == -1 ? -x : x;
    }

    static long m1(long x) {
        return ((x % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;
    }

    static void dfs1(int x, long v) {
        if (v > n) return;
        if (x > 6) return;
        cnt++;
        ve[x].add(m1(cnt - v));
        sum[x] += m1(cnt - v);
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
            dfs1(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int x, long v) {
        if (v > n) return;
        if (x >= 1) {
            if (v * N * 10 > n && v * N + N - 1 <= n) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
                    long val = m1(cnt - v);
                    int pos = lowerBound(ve[i], mod1 - val);
                    ans = (ans + val * ve[i].size() + sum[i] - mod2 * (ve[i].size() - pos)) % mod2;
                }
                cnt += tmp;
                return;
            }
            cnt++;
            ans = (ans + m1(cnt - v)) % mod2;
        }
        for (int i = (x == 0 ? 1 : 0); i <= 9; ++i) {
            dfs2(x + 1, v * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 10; ++i) {
            ve[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        n = (int) read();
        dfs1(0, 0);
        tmp = cnt;
        cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(ve[i]);
        }
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
